title: Otori Emu — 1920s Girl♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Otori Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Humhumhuum♪
Yaki-yaki-taiyaki-yaki-ki♪
That was a really yummy taiyaki♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: What are you singing...?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. You sound extra happy today.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I take it you enjoyed the taiyaki we had for dessert?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! And it was super wonderhoy because they came in four different flavors♪

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Red bean paste, cream cheese, matcha and... Ah, there was also a chocolate-filled one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup yup!
I didn't know which to choose because they all looked so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And yet, you still ended up trying all of them...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I bet you never would've been able to choose if we hadn't offered to give you some of ours.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
B-But they all looked that good!
There was no way I could choose just one!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: To be fair, you really do love taiyaki that much.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I do! I love how they look and how they come in so many fun flavors...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But these tasted way better than the ones I usually have!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Really? They tasted that good?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They tasted good...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I think that's because we all got to have them together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys have been so busy lately that we haven't had many chances to eat together, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: All four of us are here today—you two, Sis, me—so I'm super duper happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's why I think those taiyaki tasted so good!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're blowing things out of proportion again.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Still, I'm also happy about the four of us sitting down to have a fun meal together.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I agree.
We're nearly through the busiest time of the year for the company, and Mom is about to return from volunteering overseas.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We should take the opportunity to spend more time together as a family.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Including Mom and Dad?
Woohoo! I can't wait♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We even get to start working with that other troupe starting tomorrow...! There's so much fun waiting just over the horizon!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Ah, yes... I forgot that you were going there tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, is this about you and the others learning from different troupes about how to become better performers?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We get to start working with one called Shunmeiza starting tomorrow☆

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Shunmeiza...?
I just saw one of their plays not too long ago.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, really?!
How was it?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: It was a story set in the modern day about a father and child learning to understand one another after not being able to for so long...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: As undramatic as that may sound, I was very moved by it. The cast did such a wonderful job of making each character feel so real.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Shunmeiza is famous for actors who pursue realism with their characters.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Not only do they have a different style to the four of you, but I have to think they also practice in a very different way.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You think so...?!
What do you think they do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm really good at going boooing and doing backwards loop-the-loops in the air!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I seriously doubt reverse somersaults are a part of their practice regimen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm... Then...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
How about practicing belly laughs?! Rui's always saying how I'm really good at that♪
Listen...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Mwah hah hah hah hah hah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Alright, how'd I do?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, not so loud! Are you trying to scare everyone?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: I'm sure they won't be doing that either.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Aww, really...?
Hmm... Then, I have no idea what their practices are gonna be like...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I haven't heard many details either...
However, I do know that Shunmeiza focuses on developing young talent.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Which may mean that they have everyone work on having solid fundamentals.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Fundamentals...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you mean the things that are absolutely necessary for putting on good shows!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Then, alright!
That means I gotta do my very best when we practice!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I almost forgot! Rui and I are apparently gonna talk to some of the people from Shunmeiza's production team!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Oh, so you'll get to learn about what goes on behind the scenes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Rui was talking about how the people working behind the scenes play an important role in putting smiles on the faces of everyone involved in a show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I'm gonna ask them lots and lots of questions!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I wanna do everything I can to make sure all those who love Phoenix Wonderland also smile☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm gonna make that happen by learning as much as I can!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, please do.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Just don't cause them too much trouble, okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hold on, Emu... Aren't you supposed to be meeting everyone really early tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh no! You're right!
I have to leave earlier than usual because we're gonna practice a little bit before heading over!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
So, good night, you guys!
Wait, I need to brush my teeth before going to bed...!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Okay, night...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Never a dull moment, huh?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. We wouldn't have her any other way.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
I agree.
Working with a different troupe won't be all that easy.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: But we should look forward to seeing how our little sister grows.
